packages.title: Publish dependency-security issue template
packages.outcome: Publish the verified one-file structured dependency-remediation form without importing its obsolete parent history.
preconditions: bind to the current central SHA
one clean PR and one file only
acceptance: file matches verified candidate intent
ORCA CI and Vercel pass on exact final head
no main or Production action

packages.title: Repository hygiene, lint and supply-chain governance
packages.outcome: Add a deterministic lint gate, reconcile temporary overrides and remove or archive duplicated generated work products through an evidence-retention decision.
acceptance: lint blocks CI
production audit threshold passes
every retained override has owner and review trigger
runtime tree remains unchanged

packages.title: P0/P1 direct security and contract evidence
packages.outcome: Map explicit permissions and add direct denial, replay, stale, wrong-scope, concurrency and failure tests for all unproven P0/P1 APIs, Server Actions, webhooks and cron boundaries.
preconditions: freeze exact P0/P1 contract list from the latest G4/G5 artifacts
split runtime corrections from test-only evidence
acceptance: unproven P0/P1 direct-test count is zero or explicitly removed from Release 1
all required tests pass on exact final head
no weakened gate or skipped evidence

packages.title: Single-company scope and organization authority
packages.outcome: Retire legacy SaaS product semantics while retaining the security partition and implement approved branch/department/team assignments and scoped authority.
acceptance: no subscription, upgrade or agent-leasing path remains reachable
every sensitive operation has scoped authority and denial tests

packages.title: Customer identity and opportunity lifecycle
packages.outcome: Separate customer, lead and opportunity truth; implement deterministic duplicate detection, merge survivorship/reversal, consent and outcome history.
acceptance: positive, denial, merge, reversal, lifecycle and consent tests pass
history is attributable and non-destructive

packages.title: Inventory commitment, project hierarchy and tours
packages.outcome: Create the commitment/reservation aggregate, protect project/unit hierarchy and add conflict-safe tour scheduling and outcomes.
acceptance: incompatible concurrent commitments cannot both succeed
structural mutations after commitment are blocked
timezone, conflict, completion, no-show and follow-up tests pass

packages.title: Immutable offer versions and approvals
packages.outcome: Replace mutable offer truth with immutable versions, exact-version approval, negotiation evidence and safe acceptance semantics.
preconditions: approved approval and pricing authority limits
acceptance: issued versions are immutable
stale approval cannot authorize a changed version
acceptance never produces false secured inventory

packages.title: Contract and financial integrity spine
packages.outcome: Close template/signatory authority, immutable contract versions, idempotent activation, exact money, append-only correction, verified evidence, refund SoD and reconciliation.
acceptance: unauthorized or replayed activation fails
obligations are not duplicated
balances reconcile under retry, reversal, refund and concurrent allocation

packages.title: Durable workflow and communication truth
packages.outcome: Add durable workflow runs, version pinning, bounded retry/dead-letter handling and normalized communication identity, thread, consent, retention and escalation truth.
preconditions: approved communication consent and retention policy
acceptance: retry/replay/escalation/self-approval tests pass
forged, duplicate, timeout, unknown-sender and opt-out cases remain safe

packages.title: Documents, privacy, reporting and export controls
packages.outcome: Build an evidence-safe document boundary, approved privacy/retention lifecycle, versioned metric lineage and centralized export authorization.
preconditions: approved privacy notices, rights and purpose policy
acceptance: malicious/spoofed/unauthorized document cases fail
retention and legal hold are testable
Release-1 KPIs reconcile
excessive or unauthorized exports fail and authorized exports are audited

packages.title: Item-level visual and accessibility closure
packages.outcome: Close product surfaces one page or one tab at a time using owner-approved references and independent structural/detail/accessibility verification.
preconditions: approved reference for each named surface
stable functional contract for the surface
acceptance: Light/Dark, RTL, responsive, states, forms, keyboard, focus and accessibility evidence pass
no batching of unapproved tabs or adjacent surfaces

packages.title: Providers, AI and regulated business activation
packages.outcome: Prepare provider-specific, AI-use and regulated-action activation packages only after company ownership, contracts, locations, budget, licenses and official authority are evidenced.
acceptance: company-owned account and exit evidence
failure/replay/redaction/evaluation tests
every enabled regulated action maps to current authority

packages.title: Non-production migration, recovery, E2E, UAT and handover
packages.outcome: Rehearse migrations and restore/recovery in an approved isolated environment, prove deterministic launch-critical journeys, then execute UAT, training and handover.
preconditions: separate migration/data authorization for any rehearsal
acceptance: measured restore and reconciliation meet approved targets
critical browser and failure journeys pass
named UAT signers accept defects, runbooks, training and support terms

packages.title: Main and Production activation
packages.outcome: Create a single-use activation record for one accepted artifact only after every prerequisite package and release condition is verified.
preconditions: all Release-1 P0/P1 packages closed or formally accepted
acceptance: exact PR/SHA authorization
all required checks green on exact artifact
health, integrity, security and business observation window passes
rollback/forward-fix decision remains valid
